limits: This scoped launch review is not a prediction that all methods complete. Removing postannouncement IBM opportunities can change allocation before O's announcement; a newly selected preannouncement O position can still refuse. Preserve any such result instead of backdating eligibility.

The settlement probes invoke the unchanged existing settlement function on small synthetic book objects with actual source factors and bars. They prove the repaired metadata path and refusal behavior, not a completed portfolio replay.
No registry mutations, protocol claims, market replay, model retraining, parameter tuning, source/config edits or broad tests were made. The only intended write is this requested review evidence.

Original producer row scans projected only retained forecast/context schema fields; original Parquet quote-date metadata spans 2017-01-03 through 2021-12-31. No protected 2024+ price/outcome data was used.

Standard-root identity after each resumption remains the disclosed Theta exact-symbol assumption. Normalized files lack independent per-row root/deliverable fields. This unchanged input limitation was not silently promoted to independent root proof.

The complete event chain and application of prior-exposure protocol history remain also assigned to the independent integration lens. This lens verified read-only current state, schedule equality, prior range and linkage digest.
Q2/Q3 eligibility policy comparability is explicitly limited; their earlier completed numerical results were not recomputed or certified under the new policy here.

Exclusion uses only symbol, quote_date and expiry; no numerical forecast, price, return, fitted weight or prior selection enters it.
